title: potentilla aurea subsp. ternata
intro: Potentilla aurea subsp. ternata, commonly known as Golden Cinquefoil, is a perennial plant species that belongs to the Rosaceae family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, primarily due to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial activities, which contribute to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Potentilla aurea subsp. ternata include wound healing, antiseptic, and anti-inflammatory effects, making it a valuable herb in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
